title: Sideways Tomato Planting Technique
reason: Describing the process of planting tomatoes sideways.

tasks.task: Describe the process of planting tomatoes sideways.

subtasks.text: Cut off side shoots from the tomato plant.
Dig a small trench to plant the tomato.
Apply organic tomato food or salt bay into the planting hole.
Lay the tomato upside down in the trench and pop it out.
Water the planted tomato well to help it grow roots.
Ensure the sprinkler system is working to water the plants regularly.
